title: 排序数组
insight: 归并排序递归拆分区间，再用辅助数组线性合并两个有序半区，时间复杂度稳定为 n log n。
pitfalls: 合并后要把辅助区间复制回原数组
相等时先取左侧可保持稳定
空或单元素区间直接返回

solutions.title: 自顶向下归并排序
solutions.idea: 分治排序左右半区并归并。
steps: merge 用双指针把较小值写 temporary，再复制回 nums[left..right]，最终返回 nums

code.java: class Solution { private int[] temporary;public int[] sortArray(int[] nums){temporary=new int[nums.length];sort(nums,0,nums.length-1);return nums;}private void sort(int[] nums,int left,int right){if(left>=right)return;int middle=left+(right-left)/2;sort(nums,left,middle);sort(nums,middle+1,right);int i=left,j=middle+1,write=left;while(i<=middle||j<=right)temporary[write++]=j>right||i<=middle&&nums[i]<=nums[j]?nums[i++]:nums[j++];for(int index=left;index<=right;index++)nums[index]=temporary[index];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var temporary:IntArray;fun sortArray(nums:IntArray):IntArray{temporary=IntArray(nums.size);sort(nums,0,nums.lastIndex);return nums};private fun sort(nums:IntArray,left:Int,right:Int){if(left>=right)return;val middle=left+(right-left)/2;sort(nums,left,middle);sort(nums,middle+1,right);var i=left;var j=middle+1;var write=left;while(i<=middle||j<=right)temporary[write++]=if(j>right||i<=middle&&nums[i]<=nums[j])nums[i++] else nums[j++];for(index in left..right)nums[index]=temporary[index]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> temporary;void sortValues(vector<int>& nums,int left,int right){if(left>=right)return;int middle=left+(right-left)/2;sortValues(nums,left,middle);sortValues(nums,middle+1,right);int i=left,j=middle+1,write=left;while(i<=middle||j<=right)temporary[write++]=j>right||(i<=middle&&nums[i]<=nums[j])?nums[i++]:nums[j++];for(int index=left;index<=right;++index)nums[index]=temporary[index];}public:vector<int> sortArray(vector<int>& nums){temporary.resize(nums.size());sortValues(nums,0,nums.size()-1);return nums;} };
